name: XTR nine-speed GS rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 207 g for the complete nine-speed RD-M952 GS middle-cage assembly in the 2006 XTR table. The SGS assembly has a different cage and is not assigned this weight. This is distinct from the earlier eight-speed RD-M950-GS.

technical_document.title: Shimano RD-M952 nine-speed exploded view: middle-cage and distinct SGS assemblies

sources.title: Shimano RD-M952 nine-speed exploded view: middle-cage and distinct SGS assemblies
Shimano 1999 STI manual, PDF page 57 / printed page 56: nine-speed XTR M952/M953 update alongside M950 hubs; family-level 200 g statement does not identify a specific cage
Shimano 2006 dealer manual, PDF/printed page 186: RD-M952 GS, 207 g, nine speeds, 33T total capacity, 34T largest / 11T smallest sprocket, 22T front difference

specifications.reference_edition: 1999 nine-speed XTR update and later 2006 XTR catalogue offering; group start years unchanged
